children: Issuance of euro-denominated investment-grade credit is projected to stay strong in 2026 despite widening credit spreads, Societe Generale's Juan Valencia says in a note. It is expected to rise further in 2027, mainly driven by supply from U.S. issuers which are currently the most active in the euro credit markets, Valencia says. (miriam.mukuru@wsj.com)
